card.name: Inside invented brand drug names
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a newly coined brand name for a drug, such as GIVLA-ARI, OJJA-ARA or XT-AMP-ZA, in prescribing-information text. It also appears on abbreviation pieces like TB-ILI.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The last or second-to-last piece of an uncommon capitalized brand name, used as the drug subject of a sentence.
modes.example: Restart OJJA<<ARA>> at a daily dose of 50

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand name written in capitals, before the remaining letters.
modes.example: Discontinue XT<<AMP>>ZA ER if serotonin syndrome is suspected.

modes.label: Lab abbreviation piece
modes.description: A piece inside a capitalized lab-test abbreviation in a dose-modification table.

card.plain: It marks the spot partway through a made-up brand drug name in a drug label.
